section_1.title: 1. Introduction
section_1.content: I. & K. PSOMA O.E. ("we," "us," "our," or "the Company") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your information when you visit our website at https://www.i-k-psoma.gr (the "Website"). section_3.direct_content: When you use our contact forms or request quotes, we may collect:
section_3.field_4: Inquiry type (machinery, parts, partnership, support, other)
section_3.field_5: Message content (your specific inquiry or request)
section_3.automatic_content: When you visit our Website, we may automatically collect:
section_3.auto_field_4: Pages visited and time spent on pages
section_3.cookies_content: Our Website may use cookies and similar technologies to remember your language preferences, improve website functionality, and analyze website usage (if analytics are implemented).

section_4.business_1: Respond to your inquiries and quote requests
section_4.website_1: Analyze website usage to improve functionality

section_5.content: Under GDPR, we process your personal data based on:
section_5.legitimate_content: For business communications and website improvement
